summary: An object layer's source is neither in the file nor linked to a file that is there, so it shows nothing.
A layer lies entirely outside the canvas, so it never shows.
A pixel layer has no pixels.
A type layer has no text.
A layer is hidden: its content is saved but does not show.
A type layer's font is not available here and is drawn with a substitute, or some of its characters are in no available font and are drawn as a box.
A code was found more than 100 times; the rest are counted, not listed.
